title: Jore
desc: Sakthi falls in love with the daughter of a corrupt politician and later competes with her brother, Vijay, at the college election. Things escalate when Vijay loses and his father gets furious.

title: Ilavarasan
desc: Ilavarasan learns that his mother was wrongly accused of her husband's murder by her own brother-in-law. So, Ilavarasan decides to get revenge and seek justice.

title: Pagal Nilavu
desc: Selvam is indebted to Devarajan, a big shot in town, for saving his mother. When he falls in love with the sister of the new police inspector, Devarajan plans to make good use of the situation.

title: Thudikkum Karangal
desc: Balu works as a clerk in Ramesh's estate and is very loyal to him. However, when Ramesh accidentally kills Balu, the victim's brother Gopi becomes furious and decides to avenge his death.

title: Thambikkottai
desc: While on a trip to Thambikkotai, Azhagiri falls in love with a local don's daughter. However, things turn awry when Azhagiri discovers that his late father had some association with the village.
